story: Tesla battery storage will accelerate exit of coal generators
text: It's a chemical reaction - there's a gradual degradation in the anode/cathode as a reaction with the electrolyte. There's environmental factors to it too - temperature has an effect, and if you can control the temperature over time, you can reduce the effect. This lecture (1h, 13m) goes into it in detail, including how it can be prevented, ways of testing, and more: [VIDEO]

story: Tesla Model S battery degradation data
text: Battery science is fascinating. Here's in an-depth look at degredation: [VIDEO] The speaker (Jeff Dahn -- he now works with Tesla) pioneered a faster way to tell how fast a battery will degrade (which means you can iterate your design faster!)
